Alfa Connectome exploratory data analysis — full datasets

Scope: complete training and validation datasets. Exact streaming statistics are explicitly separated from bounded-sample multivariate analyses. The validation scoring mask and targets are used for evaluation research only and are unavailable at test inference.

Measured findings

  • All 212,140,000 training rows and all 37,460,000 validation rows were streamed. Exact feature moments, activity rates, target counts, target moments, sequence summaries, and validation-mask summaries use the complete files.
  • No Arrow nulls or nonfinite feature values were found in either complete dataset. This is an exact full-file result.
  • Validation scores 3,528,273 rows: 9.466% of required prediction rows. Scored runs have median length 2.0 and 90th percentile 8.0 rows.
  • The full training target correlation is -0.7222; the correlation on scored validation rows is -0.7161.
  • A sequence-held-out feature-only domain diagnostic reached AUC 0.7740 (logistic) and 0.9119 (shallow boosting). This measures separability of sampled train and validation rows, not hidden-test similarity.
  • A sequence-held-out feature-only validation-mask diagnostic reached AUC 0.8165 and 0.8509. The mask is unavailable to submissions; this is descriptive only.
  • The largest sampled marginal distribution shift is i1_v18 (KS distance 0.2543). KS values are effect sizes on bounded row samples; dependent rows invalidate ordinary IID p-value interpretations.
  • For scored validation t0, zero targets are 22.15%, values outside ±2 are 3.30%, and the largest-weight 10% of rows supply 28.77% of total metric weight.
  • For scored validation t1, zero targets are 21.05%, values outside ±2 are 3.38%, and the largest-weight 10% of rows supply 28.33% of total metric weight.

Interpretation limits

  • Target and mask statistics are exact, but they do not reveal the hidden test distribution or target definition.
  • PCA, feature correlations, lagged feature-target correlations, KS distances, and classifiers use 64 deterministic rows per sequence. Nearby rows remain dependent; these results are exploratory and carry no IID significance claims.
  • Sequence IDs are grouping keys, not chronological features. Any model feature must remain causal within a sequence.
  • The repeated value −5.199337 is measured exactly, but its semantic meaning is undocumented. Treat a sentinel indicator as a hypothesis to test.
  • The public validation mask should remain an evaluation tool. Optimizing specifically for a predictable public mask risks overfitting a mechanism that may differ on hidden test data.

Recommended next experiments

  1. Weighted ridge and small MLP references on raw features, evaluated with official global WP.
  2. Ablate causal first differences, exponential averages, and repeated-value indicators one family at a time.
  3. Train a compact GRU with sequence-level state handling; compare shared versus target-specific heads.
  4. Compare MSE, target-specific weighted MSE, and a stable mixed correlation/regression objective.
  5. Measure every candidate on identical sequences and benchmark exported row-at-a-time inference.

Reproduction

Run python scripts/run_eda_full.py. The script refuses to overwrite its output directory. Machine-readable summaries and CSV tables accompany this report.

Seed: 20261101. Script SHA-256 and source metadata are recorded in summary.json.
